parameters.experiment: Q3 intraday load-correction forward forecast comparison (F0/F1/F2)
parameters.specification: reports\问题三\问题三_日内负载修正前向预测对照实验方案.md

groups.F1_hist_mean: 0:00 forecast + rolling historical mean residual ybar
groups.F2_intraday_linear: 0:00 forecast + rolling historical intercept a + rolling historical slope beta times the same-day recent one-hour bias b

parameters.residual: e[k,h] = truth_load[k,h] - issued_load[k,h] (kW); positive = load under-forecast
parameters.recent_feature: b[k,r] = mean(e[k, s_r-6 .. s_r-1]), s_r = 6r; all six slots must be valid
parameters.labels: y[k,r,j] = mean(e[k, s_r+6j .. s_r+6j+5]) for j = 0..23-r; the midnight tail y_tail[k,r] = e[k,144] is a separate 10-minute slot; 36 hour groups + 3 tail groups

history.definition: d in [max(0,k-28), k-1], b and y valid for that group, and the required true intervals already ended at the day-k r:00 instant
history.rule: F1 and F2 share exactly the same history set, filtered on b validity too; the label is always the frozen 0:00 forecast error
history.no_backfill: early invalid dates are never replaced to reach 28 samples; one history date contributes exactly one (b, y) point

parameters.estimation: closed-form univariate least squares with intercept, no regularisation and no grid search; beta is not constrained to be positive, below one, or decaying

fallback.m_below_min: F1 and F2 corrections are both 0 and fall back to F0
fallback.degenerate_variance: var(b) <= 1e-10 kW^2 -> beta = 0, a = ybar, F2 = F1

parameters.application: one correction per full hour applied to its six 10-minute slots; final power clipped at zero; every node corrects the original 0:00 forecast without accumulating earlier node corrections; the 0:00 version keeps the original forecast including the midnight auxiliary slot and the template tail

evaluation.main_set: A = {(k,r,h): formal 334 days, r in {6,12,18}, s_r <= h < s_r+36}, 36072 unique realised 10-minute targets, 06:00-24:00 only
evaluation.secondary_set: B = each publication's full future window (109/73/37 slots), 73146 records with overlapping targets: diagnostic only
evaluation.tail: 1002 midnight-tail records over 334 distinct realised midnight intervals predicted by three versions
evaluation.metrics: MAE / RMSE / Bias / mean positive residual / mean negative residual magnitude, all with the same N as denominator; the primary metric is the A-set 10-minute MAE and is not switched after the fact
evaluation.hourly: six clipped published predictions are averaged first, then compared with the realised hourly mean
evaluation.paired: group differences are paired record by record

parameters.gate: primary gate is the A-set 10-minute MAE; differences <= 1e-08 kW are numerically tied and are not called an improvement. F2 must beat both F0 and F1 to be called better on the primary metric in this one-year forward backtest; no automatic model upgrade.
parameters.solver: closed-form arithmetic only: 0 LightGBM fits, 0 MILP/LP/DP, 0 storage replay, 0 public-January rerun, 0 PV rebuild, 0 q75 rebuild, 0 grid search
parameters.validation: three light checks only: input/history-eligibility/boundary, local closed-form and fallback, archive and scoring read-back

dependency.note: closed-form univariate rolling fits are NOT zero and are counted separately in fit_counts

amendments.reason: the boundary and archive checks subtracted arrays containing legitimate NaN (past slots of a 6/12/18 publication), so np.max would have silently passed; a mask-aware comparator now proves the applicability masks agree first

the boundary check compared every version of the perturbed day, but perturbing an earlier publication legitimately moves a later node's same-day feature; it now requires only the perturbed node's own publication to stay fixed and records the downstream change separately
